summary_en: Recruit Holdings extended the acquisition period for its share buyback program. Details regarding the maximum amount, number of shares, percentage of outstanding shares, acquisition methods, and revised end date require additional disclosure pages.
title_en: Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Extension of Acquisition Period)
translation_en_brief: Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd. announced an extension of the acquisition period for its treasury stock buyback program. The disclosure title indicates this is a period extension decision, but the provided PDF excerpt does not contain sufficient detail to specify the revised end date, acquisition limits, or other quantitative parameters. Further pages of the disclosure document would be needed to extract the specific terms including the maximum acquisition amount, number of shares authorized, percentage relative to outstanding shares, acquisition methods (such as ToSTNeT-3 or open market purchases), and the new acquisition period end date.
